_about: A small SYNTHETIC library for the screenshot re-derivation (D-07) and the
fence (V12). Every id, every dimension and every word of text here was
invented for this file. Nothing from ~/StudyRoom appears in it.
`fmt`/`w`/`h`/`model` are a RECIPE the suite turns into header bytes: the
suite writes a PNG signature + IHDR, or a JPEG SOF0 (plus an APP1/Exif
IFD0 carrying tag 0x0110 when `model` is set). Storing built binaries
instead would hide the one thing these cases are about.
`class` is the assertion this row exists to carry, in words, so a failure
names the case rather than an id.
TEST 1 = no TIFF camera `Model` AND (w,h) on the exact device-screen table.
TEST 2 = Vision's own `screenshot` label present in the cache entry themes.

items.class: test 1 AND test 2 — a plain screenshot at an exact screen size
items.text: 9:41 LTE 100% Settings General About Name Study Room Software Version 26.5.1 Model Number synthetic fixture row, not a real device

items.class: TEST 1 ONLY — exact screen size, no camera model, and Vision did not label it a screenshot
items.text: 8:15 5G 74% a long enough page of invented words that the clean predicate passes it comfortably

items.class: TEST 2 ONLY — screenshot dimensions but a real camera Model, so test 1 refuses it and Vision's own label rescues it
items.text: 10:02 Wi-Fi 63% another invented page of words, long enough that a clean succeeds on it

items.class: THE FALSE POSITIVE — carries the screenshots tag today, is in neither test, and the pass must REMOVE the tag
test 1 AND test 2 — the REVERSED orientation of a screen size, which the table must cover
items.text: 7:30 a landscape capture with plenty of invented words on it, well past thirty

items.class: THE SUB-30 SCREENSHOT — in the union, but its clean fails, so it yields no note and stays a picture. Also the first shot of the burst.

items.text: 9:41 LTE 100% the second shot in the burst, carrying enough invented words to clean

items.class: burst member — 13 s after s107, so it joins s106 only TRANSITIVELY (25 s apart)
items.text: 9:41 LTE 100% the third shot in the burst, also carrying enough invented words to clean

items.class: FENCED never_show — a screenshot by both tests, and the pass must not look at it, not count it, and not touch its tag
FENCED unknown state — fail-closed, the fifth class a hand-rolled four-class copy would admit
FENCED keys-file path class — origin_path is filled in by the suite from study_lib.keys_file_path()
NOT A PHOTOGRAPH — a note. The type filter runs first, so it never enters any count at all.

burst._about: The one known burst in this fixture: 12 s then 13 s, so s106 and s108 are 25 s apart and join only TRANSITIVELY.
